title: Verify Tipper Axis Referencing and Motion Indicators on Visu_MCP_Dual (A1/Z1/A2/Z2)
summary: On the tipper operator HMI screen Visu_MCP_Dual, verify that the left (A1/Z1) and right (A2/Z2) gripper axes show the correct referencing indicator (green 'R' circle) and determine whether an axis is currently moving (yellow data field). An axis that is out of reference may contribute to a tipper fault.
when_to_use: Use when investigating a tipper fault and you need to confirm whether the left/right tipper axes are referenced and whether an axis is currently moving based on the Visu_MCP_Dual indicators.
roles_and_responsibilities: Operator: Navigate to the Visu_MCP_Dual screen and read the axis position values and referencing/motion indicators.
safety_notes: The Visu_MCP_Dual screen includes movement controls; the manual jog function is intended for maintenance personnel (do not jog unless you are authorized/qualified per site practice).

access_required: Access to the operator station tipper HMI to view Visu_MCP_Dual

visual_references.description: Visu_MCP_Dual (Operator Station Control Panel) showing the primary operator interface and cycle indicators for axis referencing.

steps.title: Open the primary tipper operator screen Visu_MCP_Dual
steps.purpose: Get to the screen that displays the left/right axis position boxes (A1/Z1 and A2/Z2) and the cycle referencing indicator ('R').
steps.instruction: On the operator station HMI, navigate to the primary screen labeled "Visu_MCP_Dual" (Tipper Machine Control Panel).
steps.expected_result: The Visu_MCP_Dual screen is visible with the axis position boxes labeled A1, Z1, A2, Z2 and the cycle referencing indicator labeled with the green 'R' circle rule.
steps.healthy_condition: The screen is readable and shows the A1/Z1 and A2/Z2 position fields and the cycle 'R' indicator.
steps.failure_condition: You cannot locate the Visu_MCP_Dual screen or the A1/Z1/A2/Z2 fields and cycle 'R' indicator are not visible.

actions.label: Navigate to Visu_MCP_Dual
actions.exact_action: Use the operator station display navigation to view the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen (F3).

steps.title: Read left gripper axis positions (A1 and Z1) in steps
steps.purpose: Capture the current left gripper axis position values displayed for A1 and Z1 (in steps).
steps.instruction: On Visu_MCP_Dual, read the numeric position values (in steps) shown in the "A1" and "Z1" boxes for the left gripper.
steps.expected_result: The "A1" and "Z1" boxes show current position values (in steps) for the left gripper.
steps.healthy_condition: A1 and Z1 values are present and readable in the left gripper axis boxes.
steps.failure_condition: A1/Z1 values are missing, not updating when the system is moving, or the fields are not visible.

actions.label: Read A1/Z1 values
actions.exact_action: Read the current position (in steps) in the "A1" and "Z1" boxes for the left gripper.

steps.title: Read right gripper axis positions (A2 and Z2) in steps
steps.purpose: Capture the current right gripper axis position values displayed for A2 and Z2 (in steps).
steps.instruction: On Visu_MCP_Dual, read the numeric position values (in steps) shown in the "A2" and "Z2" boxes for the right gripper.
steps.expected_result: The "A2" and "Z2" boxes show current position values (in steps) for the right gripper.
steps.healthy_condition: A2 and Z2 values are present and readable in the right gripper axis boxes.
steps.failure_condition: A2/Z2 values are missing, not updating when the system is moving, or the fields are not visible.

actions.label: Read A2/Z2 values
actions.exact_action: Read the current position (in steps) in the "A2" and "Z2" boxes for the right gripper.

steps.title: Check the cycle referencing indicator ('R' circle) for referenced status
steps.purpose: Determine whether the axes are referenced based on the green 'R' circle rule.
steps.instruction: On Visu_MCP_Dual, check the cycle referencing indicator labeled with the green 'R' circle rule.
steps.expected_result: The cycle referencing indicator shows green 'R' when the axis has been referenced.
steps.healthy_condition: The 'R' circle is green, indicating the axis has been referenced.
steps.failure_condition: The 'R' circle is not green (axis not referenced) while you are investigating a tipper fault.

actions.label: Verify green 'R' circle
actions.exact_action: Check whether the circle is green; if the circle is green, the axis has been referenced.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the axis referencing indicator does not show referenced (green 'R' rule) while the system is faulting.

steps.title: Observe whether the axis data field is yellow (axis in motion)
steps.purpose: Determine whether an axis is currently moving based on the yellow data field indicator.
steps.instruction: On Visu_MCP_Dual, observe the axis data field color; confirm whether it is yellow (indicating the axis is in motion).
steps.expected_result: The data field is yellow when the axis is in motion.
steps.healthy_condition: If the system is not actively moving the axis, the data field is not yellow; if it is moving, it appears yellow.
steps.failure_condition: The data field color behavior does not match the expected referenced/motion indicators during the fault investigation (e.g., unexpected lack of motion indication when motion is occurring, or unexpected motion indication when the system should be idle).

actions.label: Check yellow motion indicator
actions.exact_action: Observe whether the data field is yellow when the axis is in motion.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the screen behavior does not match the expected referenced/motion indicators.

steps.title: Interpret out-of-reference condition as a potential contributor to tipper fault
steps.purpose: Use the screen’s referencing rule to identify an out-of-reference condition that may contribute to a tipper fault.
steps.instruction: If the axis is out of reference (i.e., the green 'R' circle rule is not satisfied), note that an out-of-reference axis may cause a tipper fault.
steps.expected_result: You have identified whether the axis is out of reference based on the cycle 'R' indicator rule, and you can state that this condition may contribute to a tipper fault.
steps.healthy_condition: The axis is referenced (green 'R' circle) when investigating a fault, or the out-of-reference condition is not present.
steps.failure_condition: The axis is out of reference (not referenced per the green 'R' rule) during a fault investigation.

actions.label: Note out-of-reference condition
actions.exact_action: If the axis is out of reference (not referenced per the screen’s green 'R' rule), note that an out-of-reference axis may cause a tipper fault.

stop_or_escalate_if: Stop and escalate if the axis referencing indicator does not show referenced (green 'R' rule) while the system is faulting.

success_criteria: A1/Z1 and A2/Z2 position values (in steps) are visible and readable on Visu_MCP_Dual.
The cycle referencing indicator follows the rule: green 'R' indicates the axis has been referenced.
The axis data field shows yellow when the axis is in motion.
healthy_conditions: Green 'R' circle indicates referenced axis status.
Yellow data field appears only when the axis is in motion.
failure_conditions: Referencing indicator does not show referenced (green 'R' rule not satisfied) while the system is faulting.
Screen behavior does not match expected referenced/motion indicators.
escalation_guidance: If the axis is out of reference (green 'R' rule not satisfied) while the system is faulting, stop and escalate for further troubleshooting.

source_refs.quote_or_summary: Item 10: A1/Z1 show current position (in steps) for left gripper; A2/Z2 show current position (in steps) for right gripper. The 'R' in the cycle denotes whether the axis has been referenced: if the circle is green, the axis has been referenced. The data field will be yellow when the axis is in motion. An axis being 'out of reference' may cause a tipper fault.
F3 navigates to the "Visu_MCP_Dual" screen; NOTE: this will be the primary screen that operators need to use.

missing_details: The packet does not provide explicit per-axis mapping of the yellow motion indicator to A1 vs Z1 vs A2 vs Z2; it only states that the data field will be yellow when the axis is in motion.
The packet does not provide explicit UI labels for the exact location/label of the yellow data field beyond the general rule; operators should rely on the visible color change on Visu_MCP_Dual.
